<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (two signals), and 127.40 (two signals) fall within the aromatic region (≈120–150 ppm). Counting these gives 6 aromatic carbon signals. The remaining peak at 168.20 ppm is a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
